Internal PGEN Regression Test Helpers

grom_pgen_test_helpers.Rd

Internal helpers used by the package test suite to verify low-level PGEN reader buffer validation and workspace-memory diagnostics.

Usage

grom_test_readlist_buffer_contract(
  pgen_file,
  raw_sample_ct,
  first_variant_1based,
  variant_count,
  sample_subset,
  meanimpute = TRUE,
  rounded_mean = FALSE
)

grom_test_pgen_workspace_estimate(
  pgen_file,
  raw_sample_ct,
  sample_subset,
  variant_1based,
  rounded_mean = FALSE
)

Arguments

pgen_file

Path to a PGEN file.

raw_sample_ct

Number of samples in the PGEN file.

first_variant_1based

First variant to decode, using one-based indexing.

variant_count

Number of contiguous variants to decode.

sample_subset

Optional one-based sample subset.

meanimpute

Whether missing genotypes are mean-imputed.

rounded_mean

Whether imputed means are rounded.

variant_1based

One-based variant index used for the workspace test.
